page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. A diagram of braces on the upper part, with a label "Articuli coniuncti cum aliis Præpositionibus" in the left margin beside the braces, then the list of forms NE, PER, CON. Below the diagram a heading, then running text in paragraphs with a woodcut initial. Page number at top right. Catchword-free; footnote-style signature "c. ii." at foot.

main_text.l: Nelli, Ne gli, Ne i, Ne'.
Per li, Per gli, Pelli, Peri, Pe i, Pe'.
Con li, Con gli, Colli, Co i, Co'.
main_text.head: DE ARTICVLORVM VSV.
main_text.p: OMNES fere articuli vocib. tantum communibus præponi solent. Dixi fere, quod aliquando articulus, LA, præponatur nominib. propriis, vt suo loco demonstrabitur.
Articulus itaque, LO, datur vocib. incipientibus à vocali: sed litera, O, e-

page.notes: The initial "O" of OMNES is a large woodcut initial. The signature "c. ii." sits at the foot. Some words in the text are printed with spacing irregularities; the text above follows the printed letters as far as they can be read. The lower-left initial and the faint show-through text from the reverse side are omitted.
